sources.locator: Locally disabling gradient computation / Setting requires_grad
sources.excerpt: only leaf tensors with requires_grad=True will have gradients accumulated into their .grad fields.
sources.note: 已讀 Setting requires_grad 全節：前向只在至少一個輸入需梯度時建圖；反向只累積到 requires_grad=True 的 leaf；Module.requires_grad_ 遞迴作用於參數。凍結下游文字參數不會切斷對其可微輸入的鏈式求導。
